title: BlueMap
what: A 3D map of the world in a web browser. It draws the map by itself as the world changes.
steps: Accept its download terms first: open plugins/BlueMap/core.conf and set accept-download to true, then restart.
Open the map with the button on the Mods page.
Drawing a big world takes a while and uses the PC's power; Pause stops it.

buttons.label: Draw a map again from scratch
buttons.warning: The drawn map is deleted and drawn again, which takes a while.
